problem_statement: B09v policy selection and future canonical Context/Calculation/Eligibility require one causal CandidateDecision.decision_time, but the current bounded recommendation path exposes only legacy created_ts and persistence occurred_at, neither of which is sufficient authority.

required_preconditions: all canonical candidate-affecting source inputs intended for the decision are identified
canonical Program identity is explicitly supplied or otherwise independently established without field/season latest fallback
exact scoped FieldProgram fact/version used for Context is bound
all pre-boundary reads that influence canonical Candidate semantics are complete
proposed_authority.placement_rule: freeze once after canonical input acquisition/binding is complete and before canonical Candidate computation begins
proposed_authority.post_boundary_rule: no read occurring after the boundary may alter canonical Candidate fields unless it is an as-of read explicitly bounded to the same decision_time and its immutable ref is added to the boundary envelope

boundary_envelope_required_refs.evidence_qualification_refs: nonempty/explicit for paths that claim QUALIFIED_EVIDENCE support
boundary_envelope_required_refs.field_program_fact_ref: exact immutable fact identity, not program_id-only latest lookup
boundary_envelope_required_refs.context_snapshot_ref: canonical snapshot built from the exact bound Program/context inputs
boundary_envelope_required_refs.forecast_refs: optional until MCFT is complete; if absent, FORECAST criterion cannot be SATISFIED
boundary_envelope_required_refs.source_input_refs: exact immutable decision input refs used by canonical Candidate computation

program_binding_rule.current_legacy_behavior: resolveProgramIdForRecommendation may use explicit rec.program_id or field/season ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 1 fallback
program_binding_rule.canonical_behavior: field/season latest fallback is forbidden for canonical Context/policy anchoring
program_binding_rule.recommended_v1_rule: canonical path requires an explicit program selector that is server-verified against one exact scoped FieldProgram fact; caller selector is a lookup key only, never authority

explicitly_forbidden_decision_time_sourc: decision_recommendation_input_facts_v1 fact occurred_at as currently written after recommendation computation
wall clock fallback inside Candidate projection

reasons: currently persisted after recommendation computation has already occurred
does not freeze all canonical authority refs required by future B-Line path
created_ts/occurred_at therefore cannot be retroactively treated as decision_time
existing_input_fact_adjudication.future_option: may inspire or be replaced by a governed canonical boundary envelope, but no compatibility type is promoted automatically

next_gate_if_authorized: freeze exact BoundaryEnvelope contract fields and identity semantics
define exact Program fact read/binding semantics and context snapshot provenance
register producer/consumer topology in B02 before runtime implementation
prove B09v selector can consume bound Candidate/Context on shadow data
keep FORECAST unresolved until MCFT completion and separate authorization
do not connect B07e without separate authorization
